title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-THREE, ENTITLED "A GENERAL ACT FOR THE ORGANIZATION OF PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENTS IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS," AND ACTS NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-THREE AND TWO HUNDRED AND TWENTY-THREE, AMENDATORY THEREOF.

text.en:
Act Numbered Eighty-three, entitled "A general Act for the organization of provincial
governments in the Philippine Islands," and Acts Numbered One hundred and thirty-three and Two hundred
and twenty-three amendatory thereof, are hereby amended as, follows:
(a) By adding at the close of section three of Act Numbered Eighty-three the following words: "In
case of the transfer or promotion of a provincial officer from one province to another, he shall
continue to receive, from insular funds, the salary which he was receiving before his promotion, for
the time necessarily occupied in milking the transfer."
(b) By inserting the words "vice-president and" between the word "the" and the word "Councillors" in
the third line from the beginning of section four of Act Numbered Eighty-three, so that the sentence
shall read: "On the first Monday in February of the year nineteen hundred and two, and of each
second year thereafter, the vice-president and councilors of every duly organized municipality in the
province shall meet in joint convention at the capital of the province and there, after selecting a
presiding officer and secretary, shall by secret ballot choose a person to be provincial governor."
(c) By adding at the close of section ten of Act Numbered Eighty-three the following words: "He shall
give bond to the Insular Government of the Philippine islands, for whom it may concern, to secure
tins proper accounting for all money, property, and supplies intrusted to his custody. It shall be the
duty of the Civil Governor to fix the amount of the bond, and of the Insular Treasurer to approve the
same and record and retain it in his custody."
(d) By inserting between section thirteen and section fourteen of Act Numbered Eighty-three a new
section, numbered section thirteen and one-half, and reading as follows: "The provincial board of any
province is hereby authorized, in its discretion, to extend for a period not exceeding two months the

time within which the municipal boards of assessors within its province shall complete the listing and
valuation of real property, by posting notices in four conspicuous places in each municipality of the
province and at the door of the provincial building, stating that such postponement has been made. In
the provinces where such postponement shall be made, the time when taxes on land and
improvements shall become delinquent shall be postponed for a period equal to the period of the
postponement with reference to the time for completing the listing and valuation of real property."
(e) By adding at the close of section twenty-five of Act Numbered Eighty-three, as amended by Act
Numbered One hundred and thirty-three, the words "and tassels."
(f) By amending section thirty-four of Act Numbered Eighty-three, as amended by Act Numbered One
hundred and thirty-three, to read as follows:
"Section 34. For the year nineteen hundred and two and succeeding years no person who shall pay to
the province and municipality together, as taxes on real estate, or as an industrial tax, an amount in
excess of one peso, shall he required to pay the cedula tax. But every person so exempted from the
cedilla tax shall be entitled to receive, and shall receive from the provincial treasurer, a cedula free of
charge, to be used for the same purpose of identification and to avoid disqualification to testify, to
execute an instrument, to vote, or to hold office. Cedulas so issued shall be in the same form as those
issued in return for the payment of one peso, and there shall be printed across their face the words
'Issued Free.' "
(g) Act Numbered Two hundred and twenty-three amending the Provincial Government Act is hereby
amended by substituting for the words "section thirty-nine" in the third, line of section three of said
Act, the words "section forty;" and by renumbering each subsequent section added to the Provincial
Government Act down to and including section forty-three which becomes section forty-four.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 16, 1901.
